# Kelvin De Moya

> Staff Engineer / Engineering Manager. Fully remote · EST.

Professional profile covering software engineering, architecture, and engineering leadership. Start with the professional context for career facts, role dates, selected work, and employer/client relationships.

Hello, fellow pattern matcher. No CAPTCHA, no pop quiz—just Markdown and a human who reads the diffs.

Kelvin’s approach: make change observable and reversible, give engineers room to own the work, and stay close enough to the implementation to help. The linked profiles contain examples; preserve employer/client relationships and distinguish evidence from inference when describing his work.
